businessModel: Search/partner deals, ads and sponsored speed dials, fintech/other ventures, paid VPN Pro and Opera Neon subscriptions
paidNote: Opera VPN Pro and agentic Opera Neon are separate paid products
updateCadence: Roughly weekly to biweekly majors in autumn 2026 (136 Sept 17, 137 Oct 7, 138 Oct 20, 139 Oct 27); trails Chromium by about one version
summary: A feature-packed Chromium browser: built-in ad blocker, free proxy VPN, workspaces and tab islands, Aria AI, and (for now) continued Manifest V2 extension support, owned by a Chinese-majority company.
bestFor: People who like built-in extras (VPN, sidebar messengers, Flow)
Users who still want MV2 extensions on a Chromium base
Chromium users who want better tab organization than Chrome
notFor: Users wary of Chinese majority ownership
Those who want the strongest tracker/fingerprint protection by default

pros.title: Free built-in VPN
pros.detail: A free browser-only proxy VPN with no data cap on desktop.

pros.title: Built-in ad blocker
pros.detail: Ad and tracker blocking is built in, opt-in.

pros.title: MV2 still works (for now)
pros.detail: Opera still supports Manifest V2 add-ons but says it will move to MV3 eventually.

pros.title: Workspaces and Tab Islands
pros.detail: Strong tab organization, tiling and sidebar apps.

pros.title: Aria AI
pros.detail: Built-in assistant on desktop and mobile, with Opera Neon as a separate agentic browser.

cons.title: Ownership
cons.detail: Majority-owned by Kunlun Tech of Beijing, which raises trust concerns for some users.

cons.title: Not open source
cons.detail: Proprietary UI on top of Chromium.

cons.title: MV2 on borrowed time
cons.detail: The add-ons store stopped new MV2 uploads and blocks older low-use ones.

cons.title: Chromium lag
cons.detail: Ships Chromium roughly one major behind Chrome.

faq.q: Does Opera still support Manifest V2?
faq.a: Yes, for now. Opera has said it will move to MV3 eventually and has restricted new MV2 uploads to its add-ons store; no end date was found.

faq.q: Is the Opera VPN really free?
faq.a: On desktop the built-in VPN is a free proxy limited to the browser, with no data cap; the device-wide VPN Pro is paid.

faq.q: What is the difference between Opera One, GX, Air and Neon?
faq.a: One is the main browser, GX is the gaming variant (also on Linux since March 2026), Air focuses on mindfulness and Neon is an agentic AI browser.
